answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 50322 Country: India Title: I have four kids 1st daughter 6 years, 2nd son 4 years, 3rd son 2 year, 4th son 1 month, only me my wife, no one is available for taking care, wife is telling about operation so can we do or not? Question: I have four kids 1st daughter 6 years, 2nd son 4 years, 3rd son 2 year, 4th son 1 month, only me my wife, no one is available for taking care, wife is telling about operation so can we do or not? Answer ID: 50322 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 313/261/B=01/1435) In this case if none is available to take care and you are not getting any maidservant then you may adopt any method to prevent the pregnancy temporarily for a awhile. It is not lawful to stop it permanently by operation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
